MARKETING HOTLINE · 60-SECOND FIELD GUIDE

WHAT THESE COMPANIES WANT TO HEAR IN YOUR INTERVIEW

Know the business. Know the numbers.

E-COMMERCEOnline stores · Fashion · Marketplaces SAASSoftware · Subscription apps · Digital tools MOBILITYRide-hailing · Car rental · Logistics FINTECHDigital banks · Payments · Lending HOSPITALITYRestaurants · Hotels · Cafés

Select a category or use the arrows to explore.

02
01 / E-COMMERCE

E-COMMERCE

Businesses that sell products online.

EXAMPLES

Fashion brands · Online stores · Marketplaces · Beauty shops

KNOW THESE METRICS

Conversion rate · How many visitors buy

Average order value · How much customers spend per order

Repeat purchase rate · How often customers return

WHY IT MATTERS

They show whether marketing turns visitors into sales, increases order value, and brings customers back.

03
02 / SAAS

SAAS

Software people access online, often by subscription.

EXAMPLES

Project management tools · Design software · Accounting apps · Business platforms

KNOW THESE METRICS

Activation · Do new users reach the useful part?

Monthly recurring revenue · How much subscription income comes in monthly

Churn · How many customers stop paying

WHY IT MATTERS

Sign-ups are not enough. These numbers show whether people get value and keep paying.

04
03 / MOBILITY

MOBILITY

Businesses that move people or goods.

EXAMPLES

Ride-hailing · Car rentals · Bus services · Delivery and logistics

KNOW THESE METRICS

Utilization rate · How much available vehicle time is actually used

Trips per vehicle · How many trips each vehicle completes

Revenue per vehicle · How much income each vehicle generates

WHY IT MATTERS

They help the business understand whether its vehicles are being used efficiently and earning enough.

05
04 / FINTECH

FINTECH

Technology that helps people manage or move money.

EXAMPLES

Digital banks · Payment apps · Money transfer services · Lending platforms

KNOW THESE METRICS

Active users · How many people actually use the service

Transaction frequency · How often they move or spend money

Retention · How many keep using it over time

WHY IT MATTERS

Downloads mean little if people never transact. These numbers show whether customers trust and use the product.

06
05 / HOSPITALITY

HOSPITALITY

Businesses that host, serve, or accommodate guests.

EXAMPLES

Restaurants · Hotels · Cafés · Event venues

KNOW THESE METRICS

Average spend · How much each guest spends

Repeat visits · How often customers return

Occupancy rate · For hotels, how many available rooms are occupied

WHY IT MATTERS

They show whether marketing brings guests in, encourages spending, and builds repeat business.
